name: Qibla Arabesque
summary: A mosque opens into an ascending directional curl, joining prayer and the journey toward Mecca.
why: The route grows directly from the architectural threshold and wraps around the open right side. Its tapered terminal turns upward, while the left dome and doorway share x=44. The whole emblem forms one connected contour with large internal spaces.
risk: The directional curl is an abstract expression of orientation. At 24px its meaning depends on the mosque context.
sub1: Direction grows from the place of prayer
sub2: A high mosque balances the low sweeping curl
theme: Prayer and orientation in one curved emblem
reasonToChoose: You want an unexpected fused symbol rather than another centered building.
